verses.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਸਬਦ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: aadh purakh aadhes kar aadh jugaadh sabadh varataiaa|

en.bdb: Having worshipped the primal Lord he made the word pervade all the yugs ,and even before the yugs i.e. before the advent of time

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦਿੜੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਦੇ ਸੈਂਸਾਰੁ ਤਰਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: naam dhaan isanaan dhiR gur sikh dhe sai(n)saar taraiaa|

en.bdb: Instructing people and teaching about the remembrance of nam (Lord), charity and ablutions, the Guru has taken them across the world(ocean)

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਲੀਕਾਲ ਇਕ ਪੈਰ ਹੁਇ ਚਾਰ ਚਰਨ ਕਰਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਧਰਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: kaleekaal ik pair hui chaar charan kar dharam dharaiaa|

en.bdb: The Guru provided dour legs to dharma which had remained one legged earlier.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਲਾ ਭਲਾ ਭਲਿਆਈਅਹੁ ਪਿਉ ਦਾਦੇ ਦਾ ਰਾਹੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: bhalaa bhalaa bhaliaaieeahu piau dhaadhe dhaa raahu chalaiaa|

en.bdb: From the point of view of public weal this was good and this way he further extended the ,,way shown by his (spiritual)father and grandfather.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਗਹਣਗਤਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: agam agochar gahanagat sabadh surat liv alakh lakhaiaa|

en.bdb: Teaching the skill of merging the cousciousness in the word, he has brought people face to face with that imperceptible (Lord)

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਆਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ ਪਰਮਿਤਿ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: apara(n)par aagaadh bodh paramit paaraavaar na paiaa|

en.bdb: His glory is unapproachable, invisible and deep; its limits cannot be known.
He has known his real self but even then he has never attributed any importance to himself.
